messages.subject: Project Tempest — engagement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Daniel,

Great to speak earlier. As discussed, please find attached our engagement letter for the Series B (Project Tempest). It sets out scope, the team and our fee estimate of £85k–£110k, plus the agreed company contributions to legal fees at completion.

Once you've signed and returned it, and we've cleared the AML formalities, we'll get straight onto the term sheet.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
